messages:
alex: Heads-up: planning to finalize the version bump now. Cutoff in ~2h. Can everyone confirm changelog entries are in and no urgent PRs stuck on blocker reviews? :alarm_clock:

sam: All changelog entries are in on my side. PR #4823 has one unresolved comment, pinged @jen a few mins ago.

mira: I'm green locally but CI flaky on linux-integration-3, failing intermittently on db-migration test. Investigating.

jen: On it, can repro the failure in docker. Might be test ordering. I'll try a quick fix; if I can't, I'll mark PR as post-cutoff and revert the bump.

alex: If it's flaky but non-blocking for prod, prefer post-cutoff label. We need to drain merge queue in 30m so we can land the bump before cutover.

tim: Staging cluster has a queued canary job; looks like it's queued behind some long builds. Requesting priority for release-job.

ops-bot: @tim marked release-job with priority 'high' in build queue.

ci-bot: linux-integration-3 rerun scheduled by @mira. Tests start in ~2m.

mira: Rerun passed. Flake caused by timeout; extended timeout on that test to 90s in PR #4823.

sam: Bump command I'm going to run:

```
../scripts/prepare-release.sh --version 2.4.0 --changelog-file changelogs/2.4.0.md
git push origin release/2.4.0
```

alex: Nice. Reminder: pin the docker base image digest in the release PR per policy.

sam: Added digest pin. changelogs/2.4.0.md includes short bullets for features + upgrade notes.

jen: I validated the build artifact signature locally. :white_check_mark: 

release-bot: Release PR created: https://git.example.com/r/release/2.4.0

alex: OK team — proceed with the bump when CI is green. If anything blocks landing, @alex will call a quick sync in 15m in #eng-releases.

sam: Launching the bump now. :rocket: 

deploy-bot: Merge queued, will wait for branch-drain window.

tim: Noted. I'll watch the canary and post results here.

mira: Canary passed smoke tests. No regression observed.

jen: Post-merge, I'll run a quick db migration dry-run on staging.

alex: Thank you. Filing a quick follow-up ticket to audit changelog links. :memo: 

sam: Done. Closing the loop — thanks everyone. :tada:
